name: PerceptEye Agent Flywheel
description: Close the loop on your OpenClaw agent: record real tool-call outcomes, claim graded rollouts, and report them back — so the model that runs your agent gets better at YOUR work. Observes only; never alters a tool result.

apiKey.description: PerceptEye flywheel key (pefw_...). Without it the plugin records locally and contacts nothing.

agentId.description: The agent name this install reports as.

capture.description: Set false/0/off to disable local capture entirely.
